headline: Executive session to discuss property tax abatements and exemptions under M.G.L. Ch. 59 §60.
summary: The Board of Assessors will go into executive session to approve prior executive session minutes and discuss abatements and exemptions. The board will not return to open session after the executive session.
items: Executive session pursuant to M.G.L. Ch. 30A, §21(a), subsection 7 to comply with M.G.L. Ch. 59 §60 to approve executive session minutes and discuss abatements and exemptions
Board to vote to go into Executive Session; Board will adjourn in Executive Session and not return to open session
location: City Hall, Office of the Assessors, 9 Dale Ave, Gloucester, MA 01930
